risks.text: The comparison assumes questionable Lamb plays, excludes Barkley as Out, and excludes Chase on bye. No uniquely matched injury report establishes current health for Olave or the candidates. Updated availability could change the optimization.

The ESPN forecasts are publisher expectations scored under the supplied league rules for verified unplayed games, not recorded performance or prospectively validated predictions. Retrieval times do not establish publisher update times; playing time and roles can change, and recorded team workload shares are unavailable.

alternative.text: Withhold these Olave-drop moves. A credible stash comparison needs longer-horizon role evidence and a separately evaluated drop with lower starting opportunity cost. The candidates are unrostered only in the test scenario; actual availability, locks, waiver priority and FAAB remain unknown.

perception.text: ESPN's Saints headline supplies negative team-level context, not Olave-specific evidence. Odunze's matched Sleeper add activity is {{11620:market-adds}}, but platform behavior establishes neither representative public opinion nor a predictive edge.
